description: Land Acquisition - Walpita, Baddegama D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters, not government personnel, organizational changes, or any other specialized category.
